Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                ORDINANCE

       BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


       SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and

Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-G in the area

bounded by

       a line 247.22 feet north of and parallel to West Webster Avenue; North
       Halsted Street; a line 222.22 feet north of and parallel to West Webster
       Avenue; and the alley next west of parallel to North Halsted Street,

to those of a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District


       SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

passage and due publication.
